standing: DRAFT - NOT RULED, NOT APPROVED. A draft authorization record for Progress the Attack (A05), for Christian's review (his reply filed 31 October 2026: the composition test moves from Secure Possession to Progress the Attack). Nothing here is in the engine's knowledge: where this file is stored in the repository, it is a document only (docs/audits/drafts/a05-composition/), and the engine loads none of it except through the TEST-ONLY draft store (back/src/system/derivation/draft-store.ts), which no production module imports. No field claims a ruling of his: ruledOn, by and ruling are empty. gameProblemId is EMPTY on purpose: A05's Game Problem is unresolved (session-planning-model.rc1.json:665-668, 'TBD'), and his reply asks that it 'should be addressed through our existing Game Problem Library rather than assigned merely to satisfy the engine' (christian-2026-10-31.txt:17). So the record gate refuses this record as drafted ('the record names no context or Game Problem', learning-goal-authorizations.ts:573), and that refusal is the first measured outcome of the A05 attempt (README section 3, run R1).
about: The record in the production shape of learning-goal-authorizations.ts (LearningGoalAuthorization at d119235), in the shape of ../ta02-composition/ta02-authorization.DRAFT.json: learningGoalId, contextId, gameProblemId, ruledOn, by, ruling, authorizedConstraints, authorizedConstraintsFinding, existingKnowledge, gaps, excluded, manipulations. It names no provisional realization, no provisional choice, no adjustment and no review request (the draft store refuses a record carrying any of them, draft-store.ts:109, :457): the test is composition from reusable knowledge, not an authored activity version. What it holds is an evaluation (which library constraints are justified: none) and the gaps the attempt measured. The Attack Development context it routes to is NOT copied here: the attempt reuses ../ta02-composition/rpc-003-contract.DRAFT.json unchanged (README section 2). `provenance` maps each field to its source or to `ours`.

record.authorizedConstraintsFinding: DRAFT, OURS, NOT HIS RULING. No library constraint has a documented relationship to Attack Development (RPC-003), to any Game Problem RPC-003 lists (GP-001 Create Space and GP-002 Exploit Space PRIMARY, GP-005 Gain Access and GP-015 Maintain Possession SECONDARY, rpc-library.rc1.json:660-702) or to the four canonical affordances. RPC-003's relationship rows reach only the game archetype, Game Problem, game form, Learning Goal and scoring event libraries; its behaviour adjustments RPC-PROP-046..049 name no object; its affordance targets RPC-MAP-103..107 are DEFERRED by Christian on 13 September 2026; every Soccer Module realization row has universal_concept_id, primary_game_problem_ids and game_form_ids null; no authored mapping joins the constraints' targetAffordancePrimary vocabulary to the four canonical affordances; and A05's candidate pool (Central Density Condition, Wide Zone Advantage, Switch of Play Bonus, Turnover Reward, Progression Bonus, and the held Pass Combination Gate) was derived by the parser from the words 'possession' and 'Progress'. Central Density Condition, Switch of Play Bonus, Turnover Reward and Progression Bonus are not justified; Wide Zone Advantage carries a plausible relevance only on Library-only threads ('wide progression', 'abandoning width;'), which only his coaching judgement can establish (README decision D7); the Pass Combination Gate stays held. Under his principle ('A library constraint is not mandatory unless its inclusion is justified by the approved knowledge and intended learning environment.', his 16 October reply, item 1) the empty set is reported as a knowledge gap. Finding of 28 October 2026 (the A05 U4 investigation), for his review: it names no constraint as authorized.

existingKnowledge.what: Two opposed teams, the opposition live and able to deny, redirect or reverse progression.
Each team attacks its own target, the two targets at opposite ends, assigned at setup and fixed whoever has the ball.
sources: contract items GF2-08.c and GF2-08.e (to GF2-03.f and GF2-03.e)

existingKnowledge.note: Which of the two is used is a realizer choice today (a04-realization-choices.json chooses line), not knowledge; where "a more advanced representative area" lies is README decision D3.

existingKnowledge.note: GF2-20 and GF2-21 are ASSUMED items with authored bases (GAK-0108, GAK-0015).
